extension.summary: Live tennis score notifications and a scoreboard of the matches in play
extension.description:
Notifies you while you watch when a tennis match goes on court, when a set is won and when a match finishes, and optionally on break points. Opening the add-on shows the matches in play with set scores, the current game's points, a marker against the player serving and a break-point marker. Covers ATP, WTA, Challenger and ITF.
Scores come from the Live Tennis API (livetennisapi.com), which the add-on's author also operates. You need a key from that service; its free plan needs no card and is enough for this add-on. Paste the key into the add-on's settings. With no key the add-on does nothing.
The free plan allows 100 requests a day, so the add-on checks every 20 minutes by default and will not check more often than every 15 minutes. That is a real limit on how promptly it can report: break points in particular last only a few points, so a check every 15 minutes catches only some of them.
extension.news: v1.0.0 - First release. - Service notifications for a match going on court, a set being won, a match finishing, and break points when enabled. - Scoreboard window listing the matches in play with set scores, current points, a serve marker and a break-point marker. - Checks every 20 minutes by default, never faster than every 15, to stay inside the data provider's free daily request allowance.
